---
name: Change proposal
about: Propose a new field, message, or capability
title: ''
labels: ''
assignees: ''

---

**What you are trying to do**
The real use case, not the change you have already designed. What are you
building, and what can't you express today?

**Why the current shape doesn't cover it**
Which existing message or field you tried first, and where it fell short.

**What you are proposing**
The message or field shape you have in mind. Rough is fine at this stage.

**Source**
If this mirrors a published standard, cite the section — NTCIP 1202 §X.Y,
J2735 §A.B, IHR (Purdue 2012) event N. If it does not mirror a standard, say so
explicitly and explain why it belongs in a shared contract rather than in your
own application.

**Who else needs it**
A field that one implementer wants is a fork; a field that several implementers
independently want is a standard. If you know of others hitting this, say so.

**Compatibility**
Can this be added without changing anything that exists? If not, say what it
breaks — that is not automatically disqualifying, but it changes the
conversation and the timeline.

**Alternatives you considered**
Including doing it in your own application instead. Contracts are expensive to
change and permanent once published, so the bar for adding to one is higher than
for adding to your own code.
